title: System Fair Persistent Identity

permissions.reason: TOBB sync stays behind the existing Super Admin gate. This change adds no permission code.
No permission catalog change. Sync remains Super Admin only.

audit.reason: Sync does not add an audit event and does not merge existing rows.

ui_permissions.reason: The Super Admin TOBB action visibility is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation item is added or retargeted.

route_guard.reason: The fairs route guard is unchanged.

forms.reason: No form fields are added. Only the sync result text changes.

notes: System Fair matching ignores calendar year, schedule dates, TOBB sequence and edition number. identity_name is the persistent label; normalized_name still stores the official wording. A second edition in the same year is not overwritten. Two or more possible matches produce a conflict that names the incoming fair and the involved fair ids. Organization fairs are excluded. Scraper fields are not overwritten. Existing duplicate rows are not merged, re-pointed or deleted. ADR-038 supersedes ADR-037 for catalog identity.
